basics.name: Ariel Gjaci
basics.label: Postdoctoral Researcher
basics.summary: Postdoctoral researcher in artificial intelligence and robotics, with a background in biomedical engineering. Research spans multimodal learning, generative models, human motion, and spatial audio, from dataset creation and model design to training and evaluation.

work.name: Italian Institute of Technology (IIT)
work.summary: Multimodal learning and spatial audio for immersive environments in the European XTREME project.
highlights: Developing few-shot room impulse response generation with counterfactual training for reverberation control (ongoing research).
Built Eigenmike 64 processing tools for MVDR, DAS, and MaxRE beamforming, binaural audio, and acoustic energy mapping on 3D room point clouds.
Implemented audio/video synchronization and 360-degree acoustic overlays for spatial-audio recordings.

work.name: University of Genoa
work.summary: Research on multimodal human motion generation and domain generalization, including a research collaboration with King's College London.
highlights: Designed ALaDiT, a multimodal diffusion-transformer for co-speech motion generation, within SICAGE (ECCV 2026, main conference).
Built and released TED4C-L: 106.45 hours of synchronized motion, audio, and text features from 764 speakers across four cultural groups.
Learned speaker-independent cultural representations with Fishr and adversarial domain generalization, evaluated on speakers excluded from training.
Developed semantic-similarity algorithms for symbolic and deictic gesture labeling (IEEE RO-MAN 2024).
Analyzed cultural cues in interaction and affective data using classical and deep learning models (AIRO 2022; AHRI at ACII 2024).

work.name: AKKA Technologies
highlights: Developed Python backend software for aircraft panels and presented a working demo to stakeholders.

courses: Research collaboration with King's College London; thesis defended in May 2025.
Thesis: Culture-Aware Co-Speech Gestures Using Generative Adversarial Networks.
Developed speech-driven GAN gesture generation tested on the Pepper robot (AIRO 2021; International Journal of Social Robotics 2022).
Thesis: Characterization of the Activity Evoked by Stimuli in Hippocampal Neuronal Networks.
